newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Notionnel can extend upside to 129.66.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Notionnel can extend upside to 129.66.

text.p: June notionnel futures on MATIF may have a little steam left on Friday to extend the morning's climb to 129.66, technical analysts said.
"I'm still giving the upside the benefit of the doubt," Neil Irving, technical analyst at 4CAST in London, said.
Irving said the initial target at 129.66 was a 61.8 percent retracement of the drop from the May 16 high of 130.76 to the low of 127.90 on May 29.
June notionnel were quoted at 129.36 at 0744 GMT, up 10 basis points from Thursday's settlement. Most European markets were flat to slightly firmer ahead of key U.S. payroll data at 1230 GMT.
Irving said if the contract managed to push through 129.66 it would target 129.80, two-thirds of the May decline. Above there, the May 21 high of 130.14 beckoned.
But Irving said most markets would key off the U.S. payroll report at 1230 GMT.
A robust figure would send the notionnel to support at 129.20,24, a small congestion area from earlier this week.
Below there, strong support comes in at 129.02/06 from the lows of the last few days. "If it does break that on a sharp reaction to the figures it would target 128.72,78," Irving said.
That level represented a 50 percent retracement of the rally from the 127.90 low on May 29.
Technical analysts at a European bank in London noted the notionnel has now retraced more than half of its May drop and had temporarily found resistance around 129.50.
Solid support arrived at 128.74/76 and renewed strength should see at least 130.00, they said in a research note. A trendline drawn off February highs comes in around 130.50 this session, they added.
At the short end, June Pibor were up 0.01 at 96.55 on the day.
